# Detect Language

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Detects the language of the given text.

## Syntax

~~~~text
detectLanguage(text: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
detectLanguage(text: "Hallo Ich Bin Zachary")
~~~~
